== Appium runtime on iOS simulators

- Automation sessions on iOS simulators that set `kobiton:runtime` to `appium` now start as expected. Previously, the session request waited about 3 minutes and then failed with `TaskCanceledException: A task was canceled.`, and no script commands ran.

// REVIEWER NOTE (KOB-55434): The parent epic (iOS simulator support) is still In Progress, and
// the 2026-08-07 release notes record a manager decision not to advertise fixes for simulator
// surfaces that had no active customer usage. Confirm that iOS simulator automation is now
// customer-facing before publishing this entry.
// REVIEWER NOTE (KOB-55434): QA did not test Appium sessions on two simulators of the same host
// at once, or installing an app with `kobiton:app` in an Appium simulator session. The entry
// avoids claims about either case.
// REVIEWER NOTE (KOB-55434): The fix changes host port allocation so each simulator uses four ports
// from 10300 instead of two. Confirm with engineering whether admins with host firewall rules need
// guidance in the device lab management docs.
